entries.zh: 硬蜡的小块（蜡丸、封蜡一类）；汉文「暗鐱」所指待考。
entries.en: a small lump of hard wax (cf. sealing wax); the Chinese equivalent is doubtful.
entries.notes: H 栏「鐱/銜」存疑、R 栏空缺，petillo 亦疑为讹写，具体器物无法定夺。

entries.zh: 掴耳光；打在耳部的一击。
entries.en: a box on the ear; a cuff or slap to the ear.
entries.notes: 西语词头 Petorego 疑为 pescozón／pestorejo 一类讹写，取义据 H「打耳」与 M「que pa hī」两栏。

entries.zh: 蹄；（转作贬称）人的脚，臭脚。
entries.en: hoof; (contemptuously) a person's foot; a smelly foot.

entries.zh: 箱笼；衣箱（皮面或藤木制的大箱，petaca 借自纳瓦特尔语，随大帆船贸易传入马尼拉）。
entries.en: trunk, chest, portmanteau (Nahuatl loanword via the galleon trade).

entries.zh: 席；草席（棕榈叶或灯芯草编的睡席，petate 借自纳瓦特尔语 petlatl）。
entries.en: woven palm or reed sleeping mat (Nahuatl loanword).

entries.zh: 簟；竹席（以竹、藤或苇编成的席）。
entries.en: bamboo or cane mat; a plait of bamboo/rattan.

entries.zh: 门前的席篷；以席搭在门口遮阳挡雨的棚障。
entries.en: a mat awning or screen set up before the door as a shelter.

entries.zh: 状；呈递官府的状子、禀状。
entries.en: a written petition or plaint addressed to the magistrate.

entries.zh: 呈上；向上官呈递的禀帖。
entries.en: to submit or present (a petition) to a superior; a memorial so submitted.

entries.zh: 诉状；被告一方递呈的申辩状。
entries.en: the written plea or petition of the accused.

entries.zh: 诉词；被告的供词、申辩之辞。
entries.en: the plea or statement of the accused.
to file a complaint; to bring a plaint before the court.
entries.notes: L 栏尾部「velachos/delachos」残损不可读，取义据 H「告狀」与 M「co chung」。

entries.en: the form or model of a petition; a precedent for drawing up a plaint.

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语为「鱼（总称）」条（g. = género），汉文与闽南语两栏原缺。
entries.en: fish (generic term); [original damaged - no Chinese gloss recorded]
entries.notes: 疑为属类提示条，汉文对音全缺，无以为据。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语「Pez brua」疑指某种鱼（或作 pez bruja），汉文栏空缺。
entries.en: a kind of fish (Sp. "pez brua", perh. pez bruja); no Chinese gloss recorded.
entries.notes: H 栏空缺，M「chiā̃ mà」所指鱼名待考，无法定夺。
